comment: T-knot densification for the recalibrated error model (2026-07-19): the honest borehole-T sigma (~42 mK vs the old flat 0.2 K) exposed coherent near-surface residual structure the 13-knot layout smooths over. The seasonal damping depth at SP is ~2 m, so the 13-15 m feature is interannual/decadal surface T -- fittable by knots. Post-1950 spacing tightens to 10 yr then 5 yr toward the present (T-information concentrates ~53x toward the present per the knot-placement study); 5 yr = the dt=5 step grid, so knots sit ON sampled years and nothing is added below the model's temporal resolution (the r6 lesson). Pre-1950 T layout and ALL b knots unchanged from r8 (b-info is uniform in time; denser b injects null-space noise per the resolution study).
